title.narrative: One Planet Summit Fellowship Programme (OPS FP)

description.narrative: This project will establish a network of up to 600 African and European researchers working on climate change adaptation in Africa to build a united African and European scientific community. This initiative will support both the work of African researchers on climate change adaptation, particularly those linked to problems encountered by smallholder farmers, and efforts to link the African and European scientific communities through science-career development fellowship courses.
